arguments.text: Fixed: isInDST's January reference is now pinned to Jan 1 of the year instead of the same day, so a date already in DST during January (like 1974-01-06) is no longer compared against itself. Note: at exactly 1974-01-06T00:00 local the zone is still PST (the 1974 shift happens at 02:00 local), so that instant is legitimately not in DST; from 03:00 onward on Jan 6 it now correctly reports true, and 1975-01-06 stays false.

Fixed: the casual/accurate conversion matrices were missing the years->quarters and quarters->seconds entries, which made normalize() divide by undefined and produce NaN. {years:1,quarters:2} -> {years:1,quarters:2} and {quarters:1,seconds:2} -> {quarters:1,seconds:2}.
Fixed: padStart now pads the absolute value and re-attaches the sign, so -1 -> "-0001" and -10 -> "-0010".
Fixed: FixedOffsetZone#isValid now checks that the offset is a number, so new FixedOffsetZone("CDT").isValid is false and DateTimes built with it are invalid with reason "unsupported zone".
